response: {"__model_dump_json__": "{\"statements\":[\"A Senior Manager cannot approve a $2,500 international trip for the Senior Manager.\",\"According to travel.md, any international trip requires approval from a manager at Director level or above.\",\"According to travel.md, any trip exceeding $2,000 total cost requires approval from a manager at Director level or above.\",\"The requirement applies regardless of the seniority of the traveler.\",\"According to procurement.md, the seniority tiers list Director as tier 4 and Senior Manager as tier 3.\",\"A Senior Manager is below Director level according to procurement.md.\",\"Because a Senior Manager is below Director level, the Senior Manager does not meet the Director level or above requirement.\",\"Therefore, the Senior Manager cannot approve the trip for the Senior Manager.\",\"A Director-level or higher approver is needed.\",\"The sources are travel.md for approval thresholds and procurement.md for seniority tiers.\"]}"}
